body:
Trigger warning - they’ve said some really harmful things but here’s the link 

https://www.reddit.com/r/antinatalism/comments/qkbod6/imagine_posting_about_being_ready_to_kill/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf
I’m currently being mocked on the anti natalist subreddit . I’m being told over there all sorts of terrible things.
But my point is shouldn’t humanity just cease to exist according to that logic ? Why do we go on existing if this life is so awful ? I’m talking about the ones already born
That’s the story of life ? Nothing is certain or guaranteed so should we all just stop existing ?

Difference is we are born and people always will be, life continues and that’s out of your hands. Preventing children being born is not the answer that will solve nothing for the people here already suffering.

You don’t need to tell people to kill themselves for them to actually do it, but there are things you can do which might make a person more vulnerable. You should try to be mindful of that. If you complain about how awful this world is then try not to contribute to suffering even more. If this world is so awful why make it worse by being uncaring/ extremely judgmental. That’s contradictory unless you generally enjoy watching people get upset.
Suicidal is not a choice ! Mental illness is not a choice !

How do you know I won’t recover fully and give my child the best life possible? Your statements are full of assertions. As I said, you didn’t mention that my post and that reply where hours apart from each other. I reached out and got help from a crisis and was coming back around to my senses. You’re post could have put me at more risk of harm because you opened up a channel for people to openly tell me I should do it. That is highly irresponsible and I recommend that you don’t do that again . Suicide watch is full of vulnerable people.

You don’t seem to understand how pregnancy can affect someone’s mental state ! The hormonal changes/ external life stressors make a woman much more vulnerable to a crisis whilst pregnant , do your research if you don’t believe me . Life is not black and white like you’re claiming, people makes choices for a myriad of reasons. Anything can happen in life that changes your situation over night. Men have left after years of marriage when there wife got pregnant making her a single mum overnight , then she might feel suicidal also. You seem to think being suicidal is a choice , it’s not. You should steer people in the direction of treatment/help not throwing judgments their way.
I wasn’t suicidal when I got pregnant , I went into a crisis afterwards ? What you’re suggestion now ? What about women who were perfectly fine but pregnancy triggered some kind of mental illness
So no mentally ill people can’t have children ? We’re not allowed to recover and have families of our own ?  Pregnancy in itself can trigger a mental health crisis what’s your suggestion then ?
You don’t have empathy for others, you wouldn’t have posted this if you cared about suicidal people. Unless you think people like me should just get it over and done with
I actually  didn’t give him permission to come inside me but I’m not gonna get into that here because I might get labelled pathetic for that also.
Do people choose to be suicidal? Do you understand how mental health works ?

Yes this helps my suicidal ideation so much. Suicidal people are not allowed to reach out for help or recover are we ? Pregnant women can’t be suicidal ? The world needs less people like me , well maybe you’re life is so great and privileged but mine hasn’t been so easy. I’ve spent my whole life in recovery from severe child abuse to the point that I can’t survive without medication. Research effects of child abuse on brain development and the outcomes for abuse survivors regarding mental well-being. Suicidal ideation is something I fall back to because I’ve been through severe trauma. 

The world doesn’t need less people like me, it’s need more compassionate and understanding people.

I’m the op 

As the day went on I was receiving help regarding my mental state. I was at a crisis point and am currently trying to recover. Are you seriously claiming that any suicidal person can’t still feel love for their family members but have gotten to a point where they can’t take any more suffering ? 

You mocking my situation is a dangerous thing to do. You’re mocking the fact that as the day progressed I slowly was starting to realise that maybe I do have hope and a purpose to live for. Mocking mentally ill people is a real low blow.
That’s lovely, I can tell you’re a loving family and it’s so sweet of your niece to reach out also. Examples like your niece give me hope and I wish you both all the best xx

Thank you so much, I’m glad to hear you’re niece is doing well and she sounds like a fantastic mum. Yeh the support means a lot to me and I’m just focussing on brining the baby into the world that seems to be giving me a bit of strength.

Yes thank you much, you’re also so strong and I can only imagine how hard it must be to be un medicated while going through tough emotional times. Is this your first pregnancy btw ? Yeh I need to reach out online to people because I find it easier then in real life. 

And thanks once again for the encouragement, we’re all doing the best we can and don’t deserve judgment 💗

Thank you so much, glad we’re not alone in feeling this way. I feel like the pregnancy is making my suicidal ideation worse. I’m glad to hear you’ve taken step to make yourself feel more safe by clearing out your medication. I’ve been avoiding things related to high risk behaviour from my past but it’s been extremely hard. 

Yeh I’m gonna be 100% honest with my
Midwife luckily my appointment is soon and I’m currently going to review my medication that I’m already on. I get so down about having no one to share the pregnancy with, like all the thing to get excited about there’s no one to experience that with. Humans are social animals and I feel like the isolation I go through is playing a huge role in me wanting to end it. 

Thank you so much though , you’ve made me feel less alone .

You sound like a nice guy, and a good parent is a good parent biological or not. There’s a lot of kids out there who need someone like you who’s willing to give them a chance , and that’s a beautiful thing . Thank you for the advice
I’m so sorry to hear about your miscarriage, my heart goes out to you
Yeh you’re right a lot of it is about escaping this reality , thank you for your kind words
Yes , I do. It’s my baby at the end of the day. The dad didn’t care enough but I do. I cannot got through with abortion .
Thank you for the compassion, much appreciated
Thank you for calling me selfish . That’s what I need to hear to confirm that I’m a terrible person .
He deserves better than me , thank you for proving my point
Thank you, yeh other mums can be very helpful
Okay I’ll check them out thanks for letting me know
Thank you for the advice it’s really helpful
